INSERT INTO contest_records (record_id, contest_id, user_id, problem_id, status, score, applied_attempt_seq, applied_attempt_id) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{contestId}, #{userId}, #{problemId}, #{status}, #{score}, #{attemptSeq}, #{attemptId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(VALUES(applied_attempt_seq) > COALESCE(applied_attempt_seq, 0), VALUES(status), status), score = IF(VALUES(applied_attempt_seq) > COALESCE(applied_attempt_seq, 0), VALUES(score), score), applied_attempt_id = IF(VALUES(applied_attempt_seq) > COALESCE(applied_attempt_seq, 0), VALUES(applied_attempt_id), applied_attempt_id), applied_attempt_seq = GREATEST(COALESCE(applied_attempt_seq, 0), VALUES(applied_attempt_seq))

INSERT INTO contest_records (record_id, contest_id, user_id, problem_id, status, score, applied_attempt_seq, applied_attempt_id) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{contestId}, #{userId}, #{problemId}, #{status}, #{score}, 0, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(COALESCE(applied_attempt_seq, 0) = 0, VALUES(status), status), score = IF(COALESCE(applied_attempt_seq, 0) = 0, VALUES(score), score)
